links.claim: Time-based, conditional and combined escrows express different release constraints. A condition can bind release to a cryptographic fulfillment, while FinishAfter and CancelAfter control time windows. The documentation describes ledger objects that persist until completion or cancellation. A browser countdown is consequently an estimate of eligibility, not proof that the object was removed or the sender recovered funds. [1]

XRPL escrow locks funds until its time or cryptographic conditions permit release; it does not judge whether purchased prose is useful or true. EscrowCreate establishes the obligation, EscrowFinish releases it when requirements are satisfied, and EscrowCancel returns an expired escrow's funds when cancellation succeeds. Expiration alone does not submit that cancellation transaction. [1]
